title: My Son Called the Homeless Boy I Took In a Thief. He Didn't Know What That Boy Drew From My Window.
description:
My son stood in my living room and called the young man sleeping in my late husband's workshop a thief. He wanted him gone that night, or he would call the sheriff and a judge. He had no idea what that young man kept drawing from my window, or who my husband had promised him years ago.

Stay until the hearing. That's when a sketchbook changed everything.
